paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the breakdown of time cost before efficient deployment, showing two components: "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." The chart is divided into two segments: a blue segment labeled "Efficient deployment" representing 26.2 seconds (30.08%) and an orange segment labeled "Reduction" representing 60.9 seconds (69.92%). The orange segment, which is significantly larger, visually dominates the chart, indicating that the majority of the time cost is attributed to the reduction component. The blue segment is slightly offset from the rest of the pie, drawing attention to it as a distinct category. The chart includes numerical values and percentages for each segment, and the total time cost before deployment is explicitly stated as 87.1 seconds (sum of 26.2s and 60.9s). The visual emphasis on the "Reduction" portion underscores the substantial time savings achieved through efficient deployment, as highlighted in the caption.
